BiblicalUsage: Milalai is named once, among the musicians who walked in the procession when the wall of Jerusalem was dedicated. He carried the instruments of David the man of God, and his name is kept with the music of that day.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the single mention is enough: Milalai played his part on the day the city sang again, and his name is kept with the music.
